[[File:Rishi_Moon_listening_post.png|thumb|right|250px|The listening post on Rishi moon]]
A '''listening post''' was a specialized facility equipped with specialized and highly sensitive [[Full-spectrum transceiver/Legends|full-spectrum transceivers]], [[Subspace radio antenna|subspace antenna]], and [[HoloNet transceiver/Legends|HoloNet transceivers]] for the purposes of eavesdropping on communications.

Due to the incredibly large proportions of such sensitive listening equipment, listening posts were typically capable of monitoring and sifting through [[Subspace/Legends|subspace]] and [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] communications within entire [[Sector/Legends|sectors]], as was the case with [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]]. Because of this, a listening post was usually located in remote and deserted places where militaries could strategically listen in on their enemies or watch for invading enemy forces.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] maintained listening posts at remote locations of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] to watch for invasion fleets of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. One such station, on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] [[Rishi moon|moon]], was [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|overrun]] by Separatist [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]]. An "all clear" signal was transmitted constantly; if there was an interruption in the signal, the Republic would consider it a signal that Separatists had either arrived in the system, alerting the clones on staff to stop the signal, or had destroyed the station itself as part of an invasion. The station was eventually destroyed, alerting Republic forces of the invasion.

The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] also had listening posts on different planets. One such was [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]], which floated above [[Ruusan 2/Legends|Ruusan 2]]. Eventually, it was [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|destroyed]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. The Separatists also had listening posts on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].

[[Nalgol]] once worked in a distant [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] listening post. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] attempted to set up a listening post on a jungle planet, although they were discovered by the Imperial forces stationed there. The [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]] had a small listening post on [[Utharis]]. [[ExGal-4]] on [[Belkadan/Legends|Belkadan]] was a type of listening post set up to monitor space for signs of [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] activity. The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] were also known to have listening posts throughout the galaxy.
